parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/RadioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.727) between `playCallsUnderlyingPlayer` and `radioPlayerStopCallsUnderlyingPlayer` reflects the natural pattern of symmetrical test methods that verify play and stop behaviours on the same underlying player collaborator — each test must remain independently named and independently executable. Merging or abstracting them would obscure test intent and violate the single-assertion-per-test convention common in behaviour-driven test suites.
